description: Update a newsletter audience's name or description.

cleanup_enabled.description: Turn list cleanup on or off. A cold subscriber gets one last-chance email in place of the next newsletter.

cleanup_ignored_issues.description: Tracked newsletters ignored in a row before a subscriber counts as cold. Default 6.

cleanup_inactive_days.description: Days without a sign of life before a subscriber counts as cold. Default 180.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.
